archetype: Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury (with High-Contrast Sports elements from Archetype 4)

headings.usage: H1 to H4, italicized accents for luxury feel. Use tracking-tight.

body.usage: Clean, modern sans-serif for body text, UI elements, and data.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. p-8 to p-12 for containers. gap-8 for grids.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Use asymmetrical 'Tetris' grid for courses and hotels.
layout_and_spacing.hero: Full screen or 90vh with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/40) over the golf course image. Large Playfair Display text.

flip_cards.front: Image background with gradient overlay bottom. White text.
flip_cards.back: Solid #1A1A1A background with 1px #CCFF00 border. Content is white/gray. Button is solid #CCFF00 with #121212 text.
flip_cards.animation: 1.2s hover delay is too slow. Change to 0.6s smooth spring animation.

buttons.primary: bg-[#CCFF00] text-[#121212] font-semibold rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#B3E600] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#CCFF00] text-[#CCFF00] rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#CCFF00]/10 transition-colors

worldwide_banner.style: Continuous marquee using react-fast-marquee. text-[#CCFF00] or outline text on dark background.

animations.reveals: Framer Motion for fade-up on scroll for sections.
animations.micro_interactions: Magnetic buttons, scale down image on click, subtle parallax on hero.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use framer-motion for page reveals and hover states.
Install and use lenis for smooth scrolling to give a premium feel.
Install and use react-fast-marquee for the worldwide banner.
Convert the site to a dark-mode first design to make the #CCFF00 lime pop beautifully and solve the 'too white/plain' issue.

Fix the flip cards: Set flip animation duration to 0.6s (1.2s is too sluggish). The back of the card should be Dark (#1A1A1A) with a #CCFF00 accent border, and the button should be a solid Lime Green pill with Black text. Remove the green gradient back.
Use Playfair Display for all main headings (H1-H3), ensure high contrast.
Implement The 'Bento' Grid for the courses section to improve flow and visual interest instead of a boring uniform grid.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
